page_title: SAL 0-4 INT | Salernitana v Inter 30/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+2' That's the end of the match.
90' 2 additional min. will be played.
89' 0 - 4 Goal! Carlos Augusto tees up Lautaro Martinez (Inter) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to score low into the middle of the goal. 0:4.
86' Nicolo Barella will be replaced by Lucien Agoume (Inter).
86' Substitution. Flavius Daniliuc makes way for Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana).
86' Paulo Sousa prepares a substitution. Boulaye Dia is replaced by Lorenzo Pirola (Salernitana).
85' 0 - 3 Lautaro Martinez (Inter) makes no mistake from the penalty spot after waiting for Guillermo Ochoa to move before rolling the ball into the middle of the goal!
85' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

84' One of the Salernitana players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle. Inter are awarded a penalty! The opposing players are protesting, but the referee had an easy-decision to make.
82' One of the Salernitana players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
79' The referee allows time for a substitution. Denzel Dumfries will be replaced by Matteo Darmian (Inter).
79' Paulo Sousa has decided to make a change. Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) replaces Emil Bohinen.
79' Paulo Sousa decides to make a substitution. Jovane will be replaced by Trivante Stewart (Salernitana).
77' 0 - 2 Goal! Nicolo Barella shows great vision to find Lautaro Martinez (Inter) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the middle of the goal. 0:2.
76' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
75' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Jovane (Salernitana) but poses no threat.
73' Neat passing move from Inter in order to create new attacking opportunities.
72' The corner is swung in but Salernitana can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
71' Agustin Martegani goes off the pitch and Pasquale Mazzocchi (Salernitana) comes on.
69' This is a yellow card! Norbert Gyomber (Salernitana) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
68' The goal by Salernitana won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
67' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Salernitana players aren’t happy.
66' Goal! Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a low shot into the middle of the net. He makes it 0:1.
62' 0 - 1 GOAL! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Guillermo Ochoa, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 0:1.
60' Jovane (Salernitana) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Rosario Abisso had an easy-decision to make.
58' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Lautaro Martinez (Inter), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
58' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
55' A substitution has been made. Alexis Sanchez goes off and Lautaro Martinez (Inter) comes on.
54' Substitution. Davy Klaassen did his best and is replaced by Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter).
54' Here is a change. Hakan Calhanoglu is going off and Simone Inzaghi gives the last tactical orders to Kristjan Asllani (Inter).
54' Jovane (Salernitana) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
52' Jovane (Salernitana) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
51' Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
50' Boulaye Dia (Salernitana) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
48' The Salernitana players are exchanging some short passes.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Rosario Abisso has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' The ball goes out of play and Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
43' Jovane (Salernitana) sends in a shot from a promising distance after a precise pass. His effort goes inches over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
40' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) goes for goal and shoots towards the left side of the goal, but his effort is well blocked.
37' The Salernitana players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
34' It seemed like Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
34' Jovane (Salernitana) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Rosario Abisso no option but to blow his whistle.
33' Nicolo Barella (Inter) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
31' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) unleashes a cannonball of a shot from the edge of the area, but it zips narrowly wide of the left post.
30' Inter are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
28' Carlos Augusto (Inter) tries to find Marcus Thuram, but he puts too much power on the pass.
27' The referee blows his whistle, Salernitana are awarded a corner kick.

26' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going into the roof of the net, but Yann Sommer has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Salernitana.
25' Rosario Abisso shows a yellow card to Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) for his blatant foul.
23' Emil Bohinen (Salernitana) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post.
23' Jovane (Salernitana) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
20' One of the players from Salernitana times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
17' Marcus Thuram (Inter) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
13' Great teamplay by Inter as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
12' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Inter will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
10' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar.
10' Carlos Augusto (Inter) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is behind the touchline and Inter will take a throw-in.
8' Rosario Abisso blows his whistle and it's Marcus Thuram (Inter) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
6' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Inter.
5' Inter enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
3' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) attempts to curl the ball over the defensive wall from the free kick, but his effort fails to reach the goal.
2' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
1' The match has just started.
Inter will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Rosario Abisso.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
